contract:
Contract ProcessSaleService::enterItem(barcode: Integer,quantity: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		item: Item = Item.allInstances()->any(i: Item|i.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and
		quantity>0 and
		item.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		item.StockNumber>0 and
		quantity<=item.StockNumber
	postcondition:
		result = true and
		item.StockNumber = item.StockNumber@pre-quantity and
		(let sl: SalesLineItem in
		sl.oclIsNew() and
		SalesLineItem.allInstances()->includes(sl) and
		sl.Quantity = quantity and
		sl.Subamount = item.Price*quantity and
		sl.BelongedSale = self.CurrentSale and
		sl.BelongedItem = item and
		self.CurrentSale.ContainedSalesLine->includes(sl) and
		self.CurrentSaleLine = sl)
}
